observations: Photo 0 shows the front of a large cardboard box for a BND Acoustics home theater system, model YM-44. The box is sealed with tape and has visible text and images of the speaker setup.
Photo 1 shows a close-up of the center speaker inside the box, resting on foam. The BND logo is visible on the speaker grille.

Photo 2 shows the full speaker set inside the box, arranged in foam inserts: a center speaker, a subwoofer, two front speakers, two rear speakers, and a remote control in plastic wrap. The items appear undisturbed and unused.
The box and contents show no visible damage or signs of use. The packaging is intact, and the items are still in their original foam inserts.

claims.claim: Bought brand new and shipped down but was never around to use it. Still very much intact.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the sealed box with no signs of tampering. Photo 2 shows all components still in original foam packaging, untouched. Photo 1 shows the center speaker with no visible wear. The condition is consistent with new, unused product.

risks.risk: The system may be non-functional or have internal defects despite appearing new.
risks.proof: A video showing the system powered on, with all speakers producing sound and the remote controlling the unit.

risks.risk: The box may have been opened and resealed, or the contents may have been used or damaged before being repackaged.
risks.proof: A close-up of the box seal showing no signs of tampering, and a video of the internal components being removed and inspected for dust, scratches, or wear.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used, with potential hidden damage

proof_requests: Video of the system powered on and functioning with all speakers and remote.
Close-up of the box seal to confirm it has not been opened before.
Photo of the serial number or any internal labels on the speakers or subwoofer.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a BND Acoustics YM-44 home theater system, and the photos support the seller's claim of being new and unused. The packaging and components appear intact. However, functionality and internal condition are unverified, so it is priced at its worst case (as not working) until proven otherwise.
